reviews.comment: I took HIST 358 Chinese History. Homework is heavy but the lectures are fun. The course also includes hands-on cultural activities, Dr. Nie even played a traditional Chinese instrument! There are many exams and quizzes, but if you attend class and keep up with the work, it's an easy course to do well in.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Took her for 380. Great professor with engaging lectures! Learned so much about Chinggis Khan and the rise and fall of the Mongol empire. There is a midterm, final, weekly assignments and quizzes. Drops the lowest assignment and quiz. This is NOT a difficult class, just take notes from the slides. Easy A, great class, great professor!!
Dr Nie made Chinese history so interesting! You have to do readings and attend lectures to obtain an A but as long as you come to lectures and write down notes, you will be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Nie is an excellent professor, and I enjoyed her class on Chinese History. She is truly passionate about the subject, and her teaching methods made the class quite enjoyable. The class itself was not demanding at all, and it was truly one of the easiest history courses I've taken. I would recommend her class to anyone.

I didn't need to take history, but Nie made the course interesting! She definitely is more knowledgeable on Asian history, so that part of this course feels more prominent, but she still does a good job giving lectures on other places in history. Just keep up with your assignments and you'll be fine since she can be pretty lenient with grades.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Nie is very caring and attentive to her students. There are lots of readings and exams are based on that, be prepared though. The class is fun, she shows video games and films to us besides reading. She also gives us lots of time between the regular lecture to prepare for the paper writing. My favorite class!

She does expect a lot of her students, and you will have to do plenty of readings, but the assignments and tests are not very difficult and the grading is very lenient. I thought it was a very interesting class even though I am a STEM major. Don't expect an easy A, but if you do what is expected of you, it is not a hard class.

Prof. Nie is an engaging lecturer and expects a lot from her students. She gives a lot of readings and requires participation, but this helps students learn the material. She was a little disorganized and would change things on the syllabus. If you do what she assigns you will do well! She is also so kind and attentive! Her class was my favorite!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr Nie is a very nice teacher, but this was one of the most disorganized classes I've taken. Additionally, the syllabus was changed mid-semester, as well as the deadlines for major assignments. Class was canceled for a total of six weeks throughout the semester, which seemed absurd.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lots of readings with questions to discuss in class for participation credit. Nie is somewhat disorganized and will change the syllabus mid-semester, but most of the time it was adjusted to our benefit so it was okay. She is SUPER accessible outside of class with super helpful feedback on writing. Overall, one of my favorite classes! She is funny.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback
